_note: The coach model (GDD 4.9.1-4.9.2, built in session C1; read by CoachSystem, scripts/core/coach_system.gd). A coach is a record: {id, name, gender, voice (the personality in data/coaches.json whose words he uses at races), kind (club / parent / remote / academy / personal), real (true = a real coach: facts only from public sources, listed in source; attributes are our estimates from those facts; a neutral professional voice, never invented storylines), source, attributes (the 11 below, whole numbers 1-20), personality (= voice), style (-2 very controlling ... +2 very supportive, words in styles), demands (steady / balanced / ambitious: the season plan he leans to), facts {birth_year, club_id, town, qualification, reputation, event_focus, cost_month, open (takes every club member), spots, min_level}, group (the training group: fictional teammates {id, first_name, last_name, gender, birth_year, event, level, role})}. Effects are measured against `neutral` (10): (attribute - 10) x per_point, so a coach of 10s changes nothing (the M1 / step 7 balance stays exact). Every number here is a first guess for the balance session at the end of M2 part 2 (GDD 4.9.7).

attributes.name: Endurance knowledge
attributes.description: How much your aerobic, threshold and economy work gives you; the quality of his endurance sessions and splits.

attributes.name: Speed & strength knowledge
attributes.description: How much your speed, speed endurance, power and strength work gives you.

attributes.name: Technique
attributes.description: How fast your running technique grows; drills done right.

attributes.name: Periodization
attributes.description: How well his season plan fits you: lighter weeks, the taper hitting your form on the day, the quality of his pick of plan.

attributes.name: Youth development
attributes.description: Under 18: protects a growing body (growth-spurt niggles) and makes the most of your first training years.

attributes.name: Load management
attributes.description: How early and how rightly he spots soreness and load spikes, and changes your days for them.

attributes.name: Race reading
attributes.description: How often his race shouts are right; his clues before a race and his marks on a race video.

attributes.name: Mental coaching
attributes.description: Mental training works better, composure grows faster, confidence comes back faster after a bad race.

attributes.name: Motivating
attributes.description: How much he lifts your motivation; how strongly his praise and criticism land.

attributes.name: Communication
attributes.description: How much and how clearly he explains why; how he gets along with your family and school.

attributes.name: Judging ability
attributes.description: How right his estimates are: time goals, what you can run, the range he gives for your potential.

effects._note: Built in C1: training (the week's trained gains per attribute group, Training._apply_progression) and race_advice (how often his shout on a race card is the sensible answer; at 10 exactly races.json controls.coach.accuracy). Prepared, not used yet (C4 / M1 / the balance session): youth_development, load_management, periodization, mental_coaching, motivating.

personalities._note: For each voice in coaches.json: lean = points added before the coach's own spread (then centred, so they only say where he is strong and weak), style / demands = weights of the draw.

club._note: The club coach every career starts with (one of the four people of coaches.json, the one picked from the athlete's name as before). User 2026-10-11: club coaches really differ (a volunteer parent vs. an experienced club coach): his overall level (the average of his 11 attributes) is drawn around 10 between average_min and average_max; on top of it his personality's lean and his own spread (spread_sd) make him strong somewhere and weak somewhere. A typical (10) club coach plays exactly like the game before C1. The dice come from his own seed (the athlete's name and birth date), so a career always gets the same club coach. Town size and region (session D1) will move the average later (small clubs lower, the athletics centres higher).

group._note: The training group that comes with the coach (GDD 4.9.1): fictional teammates of about the athlete's age (youth athletes stay fictional). level = their running level on the attribute scale (the mean of the athlete's physical and technical attributes +- level_sd; role shifts). Used by the people moments (P1) and later the group pull in hard sessions.

temperaments._note: The athlete's temperament, from the creation answer 'Before an important race, you usually...' (background_questions.json, the answer's `temperament`). Older saves have none: fit Fine with everyone.

fit._note: Fit = matrix[temperament][personality] (+1 click, -1 friction, missing 0) + style x style_weight (a supportive style helps everyone; a controlling one hurts all but the no_controlling_penalty temperaments). Score >= click -> 'You click', <= friction -> 'Friction', else 'Fine'. The word shows after reveal_weeks together. User OK 2026-10-11. It sets where trust drifts to (trust.target); motivation follows in session M1.

trust._note: One hidden number 0-100 per coach, shown as a word. New for the first new_weeks together; then Strong from strong, Strained below strained, else Good. Each Sunday it moves rate of the way towards target[fit]; results vs his goals (C5), moments (C2/P1) and vetoes (C4) add to it later (CoachSystem.add_trust). Fit alone never makes it Strained. In C1 nothing reads it.
